0022600015.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-2, first in the Southeast and sixth in the East, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Washington Wizards (2-3, third in the Southeast and ninth in the East, on a two-game losing streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with both teams five games into the season. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Tre Johnson is day-to-day with Achilles soreness and is a game-time decision. The Hornets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 110-103 win in Charlotte on October 26, and they won the 2025-26 season series 4-0.
